cases.speaker: Vinh Giang
cases.text: What makes us really nervous is being self-conscious.

cases.speaker: Jay Shetty
cases.text: When you like a flower, you pluck it. But when you love a flower, you water it daily.

cases.speaker: Mel Robbins
cases.text: The people gossiping about you are already behind you.

cases.speaker: Vinh Giang
cases.text: If you're nervous, stop thinking about yourself.
